safe_bet.title: Safe Bet
safe_bet.text: Camp at a location with a shelter value of 8 in Ice and Death, Part I.

look_at_all_this_stuff.title: Look at All This Stuff!
look_at_all_this_stuff.text: Recover all seven supplies in Ice and Death, and carry all of them to The Summit in To the Forbidden Peaks.

in_your_head.title: In Your Head
in_your_head.text: Finish Fatal Mirage with nine story cards in the victory display.

chaos_chaos.title: Chaos Chaos
chaos_chaos.text: Collect and spend a total of ten or more keys in City of the Elder Things.

knock_knock.title: Knock, Knock
knock_knock.text: Collect, activate, and place all five seals in The Heart of Madness, Part I.

mad_with_power.title: Mad With Power
mad_with_power.text: Simultaneously exhaust fifteen copies of The Nameless Madness in The Heart of Madness, Part II.

construct_additional_pylons.title: Construct Additional Pylons
construct_additional_pylons.text: Collapse all five Mist-Pylons and escape with your life in The Heart of Madness, Part II.

the_sound_of_madness.title: The Sound of Madness
the_sound_of_madness.text: Draw 10 copies of "Tekeli-li!" during a single game.

sorry_im_all_out_of_dog_puns.title: Sorry, I'm All Out of Dog Puns
sorry_im_all_out_of_dog_puns.text: Have Anyu and four or more other assets with "Dog" in their title in play at the same time.

kind_of_a_hat_on_a_hat.title: Kind of a Hat on a Hat
kind_of_a_hat_on_a_hat.text: Play a Wooden Sledge from a Backpack, then immediately use its ability to attach a backpack to it.

this_was_your_idea.title: This Was Your Idea
this_was_your_idea.text: Use Professor William Dyer's ability to heal at least 4 horror from Danforth during a single scenario.

no_respect_for_the_dead.title: No Respect For the Dead
no_respect_for_the_dead.text: Control at least five assets from the Memorials of the Lost encounter set at the same time.

wuk_wuk_boom.title: Wuk Wuk Boom
wuk_wuk_boom.text: Use Dynamite to defeat two Giant Albino Penguins at the same time.

the_cold_never_bothered_me.title: The Cold Never Bothered Me
the_cold_never_bothered_me.text: Win the Edge of the Earth campaign with eight [frost] tokens in the chaos bag at the end of the campaign.

hell_froze_over.title: Hell Froze Over
hell_froze_over.text: Win the Edge of the Earth campaign with zero [frost] tokens in the chaos bag at the end of the campaign.

abandoned_and_alone.title: Abandoned and Alone
abandoned_and_alone.text: Win the Edge of the Earth campaign without ever bringing a partner asset along with you during a scenario.

friends_forever.title: Friends Forever
friends_forever.text: Bring the same partner with you in each scenario, ensure that they have confronted their demons, and win the Edge of the Earth campaign with them still alive.

there_and_back_again.title: There and Back Again
there_and_back_again.text: Win the Edge of the Earth campaign with each of the following survivors:

line_in_the_snow.title: Line in the… Snow
line_in_the_snow.text: Win the Edge of the Earth campaign with at least three Ultimatums active.

antarctic_expertise.title: Antarctic Expertise
antarctic_expertise.text: Win the Edge of the Earth campaign on Expert difficulty
